summary: Two bounded PRINCIPAL019 candidates are complete, pending distinct review. Exact independent-label swapping and unit-character orthogonality give the actual full-pullback comparison as an integral of squares, proving positivity and set monotonicity on its label-independent input class without generic configuration-kernel PSD. For the actual balanced polynomial prime arrays on powers of two, the accepted018 nonprincipal energy is transported by a common-product Mellin transform with exact prefactor YX^2 and a character-averaged tail retaining1/H. Effective ordinary PNT gives the growing-lambda principal density model, integrable tails and central asymptotic Q0=(2 J_eta/9+O(1/L))*HY/(V_H^2 L^4), J_eta>0. Monotonicity and the negligible integer compression then prove a positive lower bound of that scale for this input's actual fractional comparison. No raw-count nonemptiness, minor-difference estimate, other-k energy, accepted-small-sift extension, pointwise prime margin, novelty or Goldbach claim follows. No experiment/helper run or new source search was performed. Usage is unknown.

claims.text: On the actual label-independent H-unit input and verified Psi plateau, swapping independent labels gives the exact character/residue-square formulas for Q_M, hence positivity and monotonicity as M grows. This is not generic configuration-kernel positivity.

Using the actual accepted CENTERED018 k1/trivial-twist theorem, common-product Mellin separation and exact B orthogonality on transform tails give Q0_nonprincipal=O_D(HY log^(-D)H) for every fixed D, with all frequency and lambda costs retained.

Effective ordinary PNT and an integrably decaying exact principal density prove Q0=(2 J_eta/9+O(1/log H))*HY/(V_H^2 log^4 H), with a finite strictly positive continuum J_eta and the full group normalizer retained.

For this actual polynomial prime input, comparison monotonicity and the honest C1 upper bound make its integer major compression negligible, so the actual fractional comparison is eventually positive and at least (2 J_eta/9+o(1))*HY/(V_H^2 log^4 H). No generic fractional sign or full-major asymptotic is claimed.

The raw-minus-full-major bound, prescribed-H raw-block nonemptiness, other arcs/arrays energy transport, polynomial Type I, the original pointwise prime margin, novelty, Goldbach and breakthrough classification remain unestablished.
